bootStaleSeconds.description: Seconds a live worker may remain in the boot phase without recorded progress before it is classified as stale. Set to 0 to disable this boot staleness bar.

staleSeconds.description: Seconds since the last recorded non-boot progress event before a live worker is classified as stale. Set to 0 to disable this progress staleness bar.

max_connections.x-cfg-read-only: diagnostic mirror parsed from postgresql.conf.template; change the template, not CFG

claude-responder.default: warm resident ATP responder bootstrap prompt is decision-only and carries no code-edit surface; live operator messages supply the actionable context

codex-responder.default: warm resident ATP responder bootstrap prompt is decision-only and carries no code-edit surface; live operator messages supply the actionable context

run_as_user.description: Optional host-local unprivileged worker account; validated before launch environment rendering.

restricted_paths.description: Sensitive paths flagged for review in the PR body; file expansions do not require approval.

netguard_root.description: Optional host netguard install with worker-readable bin/ and site/; exports NETGUARD_ROOT without changing PATH or PYTHONPATH.

max_concurrent_runs.description: Host validation slots. When omitted, worker validation uses max(2, cpu_count // 6). Zero disables admission.
